# Zero-Lag

Zero-Lag is an Expo / React Native Android app. The product is not
scaffolded yet. Budget zero. No live host has been named.

## For agents

- Project law: CLAUDE.md
- How to work: AGENTS.md
- Skills catalog: .agent/master-skills.json
- Quality bar: .agent/quality-bar.json (v40.0)
- Design: DESIGN.md
- Map: SITEMAP.md
- Decisions: docs/DECISIONS.md

Do not start an APK / EAS / Actions build unless the human names the
number. No secrets in the client.
